notes: P24 baseline policy is committed before enough historical samples exist; facility baseline rows start empty by design.
A facility baseline is established only after minSamplesPerFacility valid samples and facility-specific p95 fields are present.
Repeated observation requires both multi-source repeatability and above-baseline strength; single-pass FIRMS detections remain manual-review thermal proxy only.
This baseline file never stores MAP_KEY, raw FIRMS rows, raw URLs, outage claims, supply-disruption claims, or oil-price direction.
